name: @promopilot/broken-links
description: Check a page for broken links from the command line: every link (and optionally images, scripts, stylesheets and iframes) is requested in parallel with HEAD/GET fallback, reporting 4xx/5xx, timeouts, DNS failures, invalid URLs and redirects, with the anchor text that needs fixing. Zero-dependency Node.js CLI, library and GitHub Action. Free online version by PromoPilot.
author: Alexandr Krikun (https://github.com/ksanyok)
